extensions.scope: Seven original offline Canvas Games themes; no change to application identity.

layout.fit: contain, centered, letterboxed, clipped to the full logical scene
layout.portrait: Complete scene remains visible at a deliberately smaller scale.

label.purpose: Uppercase scene title and right-aligned simulation counters; Canvas textBaseline top.

station-label.purpose: Robot Factory's CHASSIS, CORE and ACTIVATE labels.

motion.name: simulation-step
motion.purpose: Fixed-step autonomous simulation; speed multiplier 0.3–2, default 1.

motion.name: render-limit
motion.purpose: Timer and requestAnimationFrame scheduling respect the host performance setting.

lifecycle.pause: Cancel timer and animation frame; reset timing accumulator.
lifecycle.visibility: Stop while hidden; restart when visible if not paused.
lifecycle.reducedMotion: Initially render a still frame after 12 simulated seconds; explicit host resume permits animation.
lifecycle.preview: Deterministic seeded still frame using ?preview=<seconds>, clamped to 0–120 seconds.
lifecycle.settings: Merge host settings, redraw immediately, clear existing sparks when particles are disabled.

components.name: Pixel scene
components.description: Code-drawn 640 × 360 autonomous world fitted to the viewport.

components.name: Progress strip
components.description: Optional Canvas title and live counters; square corners and no interactive states.

components.name: Original sprite
components.description: Small character-grid silhouette drawn with rounded rectangle coordinates and scene-local scale.

narrative.overview: Extend the existing Canvas Games visual world with original small sprites, recognizable environments, restrained palettes and an optional compact progress strip.
dos: Edit shared source and regenerate templates.
Keep effects bounded and honor host pause, visibility and performance settings.
Preserve the whole logical scene in portrait.
donts: Do not hand-maintain generated scene copies.
Do not require keyboard input or downloaded assets.
Do not establish a new application identity for this collection.
